one_liner: TigerShark Science grows human skin models for pharma and cosmetics testing; its BayStartUP competition result and reported EXIST funding make it worth meeting now.

top_signals.signal: Listed as a winner or finalist in the 2026 BayStartUP Bavarian Business Plan Competition.
Reported €1.3 million in EXIST funding in 2024.

Model score 78.5 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). Three known founders, a technical founder with a PhD, and the deep-tech classification lifted the score; being based in Germany lowered it. University spin-off status and a founder's top-university affiliation also lifted the score, but neither flag is confirmed by the founder records.

team: Dr. Amelie Reigl is co-founder and CEO. The founder record identifies her as a biologist with a PhD and a project manager at Fraunhofer ISC. Dieter Groneberg and Dr. Florian Groeber-Becker are listed as co-founders; their operating responsibilities are unknown.
why_early: Priced-round status is unknown. The reported EXIST funding does not establish whether a priced round has occurred.
devils_advocate_risks: The team describes production as standardized and partly automated, but performance at commercial volumes is unknown.
Regulatory acceptance of the models as alternatives to animal testing is uncertain.
next_step: HTGF Life Sciences & Chemistry team: Ask the founders what batch-to-batch reproducibility data they have at production volumes requested by pharma or cosmetics customers.
